newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria 3-mth discount T-bills 36 percent sold.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria 3-mth discount T-bills 36 percent sold.

text.p: A third issue of Bulgaria's Finance Ministry T-bills, dated September 4 to cover maturity payments on previous issues on that date was partly sold, the central bank (BNB) said.
The issue of 4.0 billion levs worth of three-month discount T-bills was 36.08 percent sold on Monday, yielding 203.04 percent, the BNB said in a statement.
Nine financial institutions took part in the auction. In line with its usual practice, the BNB did not specify the institutions.
Avg price of bids 75.85 pct of par
Avg accepted price 75.85 pct of par
On Friday, the ministry raised 5.33 billion levs, selling a total of 6.13 billion levs worth of T-bills from two other issues, also dated September 4.
The total par of the two offers, a 49-day discount issue and a six-month floater coupon paper, was 16.0 billion levs.
According to BNB data, three issues of treasury bills with a total principal of 23.2 billion levs mature on September 4. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
